subject: Error in paste0(..., "\n") : object 'filenames' not found

messages.author: b940bb03851c507a
messages.subject: Error in paste0(..., "\n") : object 'filenames' not found
parts:
Hi all,

I'm having an error while running the sumstat function.
After all the summary statistics are filtered and manipulated, the only step left is saving the merged summary statistics as Rdata. But below error keeps popping up,

Error in paste0(..., "\n") : object 'filenames' not found
Calls: sumstats -> .sumstats_main -> .LOG -> paste0
Execution halted

Below is the code:
files=c(V1, V2)
ref= paste(ref.dir, "reference.1000G.maf.0.005.txt", sep="")
trait.names=c("V1", "V2")
se.logit=c(F, T)
OLS=c(T, F)
linprob=c(F, T)
N=c(NA, 272026)
info.filter=0.6
maf.filter=0.01
keep.indel=FALSE
parallel=FALSE
cores=NULL

G0_5_2_sumstat <-sumstats(files=files,
ref=ref, trait.names=trait.names,
se.logit=se.logit, OLS=OLS, linprob=linprob, N=N,
info.filter=info.filter, maf.filter=maf.filter,
keep.indel=keep.indel, parallel=parallel, cores=cores)

save(G0_5_2_sumstat, file=paste(save.dir, "G0_5_2_sumstat.RData", sep=""))

What is causing this problem?

Thanks,

Austin

This was a bug introduced from a recent update. If you reinstall the package, restart R, and try rerunning your code it should now work. But of course if you are still getting the same error let us know. 

Thanks!
